```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8,fig.width=8,out.width="100%", fig.cap=""}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)

# ---- GLOBAL SIZE SETTINGS ----
base_size <- 16
axis_title_size <- 16
axis_text_size <- 14
legend_title_size <- 15
legend_text_size <- 14
label_size <- 5
title_size <- 16

# Read pollinator phenology
all <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/pollinator_phenology.rds")

# Create order of species for plotting
plot_order <- all %>% 
  filter(Flying_period == "Yes") %>% 
  group_by(Species) %>% 
  slice_min(Doy, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  arrange(-Doy) %>% 
  select(Doy, Species) %>% 
  rename(Order = Doy) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Order_number = row_number() * 50)

# Arrange dataframe
all_ordered <- left_join(all, plot_order, by = "Species") %>% 
  group_by(Species) %>% 
  arrange(Order_number) %>% 
  mutate(Order_number = if_else(Flying_period == "No", NA_real_, Order_number))

# Highlight species
highlight_species <- "Sphecodes albilabris"

highlighted_species_data <- all_ordered %>% 
  filter(Species == highlight_species,
         Flying_period == "Yes") %>% 
  slice_min(Doy, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(Doy = 80)

# ---- PANEL A ----
p1 <- all_ordered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Doy, y = Order_number, group = Species, color = Probability)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Flying\nprobability") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  xlab("Day of the year") +
  ylab("Pollinator species") +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
    legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
    legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 60, 10, 10)  # IMPORTANT for label space
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = highlighted_species_data, 
    aes(x = Doy, y = Order_number),
    color = "black", 
    shape = 8,
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = highlighted_species_data, 
    aes(x = Doy, y = Order_number, label = Species),
    size = label_size,
    hjust = 0,   # <-- move text RIGHT instead of left
    nudge_x = 5, # <-- push label inside panel
    fontface = "italic",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

# ---- PANEL B ----
oc2 <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/poll_occurrences_over_60_records.rds")

example_sp <- all_ordered %>% 
  filter(Species == highlight_species)

sp_data <- oc2 %>% 
  filter(Species == highlight_species) %>% 
  left_join(example_sp, by = c("Species", "Doy"))

sp_data1 <- oc2 %>% 
  filter(Species == highlight_species,
         !is.na(PollObs))

p2 <- ggplot(example_sp, aes(x = Doy, y = Probability)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = highlight_species,
    x = "Day of year",
    y = "Flying probability"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
  geom_point(
    data = sp_data,
    aes(
      x = Doy,
      y = n_individuals / max(n_individuals, na.rm = TRUE),
      color = Probability
    ),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = sp_data1,
    aes(xintercept = Doy),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Flying\nprobability") +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "italic"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 2)
  )



# ---- COMBINE ----


p_final <- p1 / p2 

p_final

```
